apps.localizedDescription: Solea plays the live TV, movies and series of the subscription you already have, with a clean interface, dubbed or original versions, profiles, resume and casting to Chromecast. Solea provides, sells and recommends no content and no subscription.

versions.localizedDescription:
## Test version

### A new TV interface
- **New home screen**: a large picture of the title you select, "Continue watching" right below, and four doors: Live TV, Movies, Series, Anime.
- **Search, Settings and your profile** are now round buttons at the top of the home screen. The remote's search or mic key opens search directly.
- **New search**: channels, series and movies in rows, with your recent searches.
- **Movies, Series and Anime in rows**: New, My Trakt list, Favorites, Top rated, then every category, with "See all".
- **Long-press OK anywhere** for options: favorite, Trakt list, move, guide, replay, remove from "Continue watching".
- **Settings reorganized** into seven clear categories, each with a short summary.

### Live TV
- **Program guide in a grid**: channels by hour, a small live preview of the selected channel, and replay in one press.
- **Picture format per channel** (whole picture, fill, 16:9, 4:3), remembered for each channel.
- **Smoother motion on Android TV boxes**: the screen switches to 50 Hz for 25/50 fps channels (Settings › Playback).
- **Frozen picture**: Solea reconnects, tries another format, then a lower quality, and explains when nothing works.
- **Favorite channels in your own order**: long-press OK on a channel, then Move.
- Each channel shows the current program, its end time and progress.

### Subscription
- **Backup servers**: add up to 5 other addresses from your provider. If the main one stops responding, Solea switches on its own.

### Trakt
- **Connect your Trakt account** (Settings › Services) with a code on trakt.tv: what you watch is marked as watched, your progress in each series is sent, and your watchlist shows up in Movies and Series. A "Watchlist" button is on each movie and series page.

### And also
- **Voice search** listens inside Solea and types as you speak (Android TV boxes with a mic remote).
- **"Continue watching" on the Android TV home screen**.
- Short announcements can appear at the top of the home screen.
- Casting from an Android box to another TV now works with the remote.

## Downloads

- **Android box, Android TV, Fire TV, Android phones and tablets**: `Solea-0.9.6-android.apk`
- **Windows**: `Solea-0.9.6-Setup.exe` (installer) or `Solea-0.9.6-windows.zip` (portable)
- **iPhone, iPad**: with SideStore, see [solea.tv/en/install-iphone](https://solea.tv/en/install-iphone/)

Questions and feedback: [Discord](https://discord.gg/42FVvupACy). Solea is a player: it provides no content and no subscription.

## Test version

### Connect a TV from your phone
- **Scan the TV's QR code with your phone's camera: Solea opens** and offers to connect the TV in one tap, to your Solea account and your subscription. The TV gets your profiles, progress and favorites. Everything is encrypted for the TV alone.
- On iPhone, the solea.tv/pair page shows an "Open in Solea" button.
- Without Solea on the phone, the solea.tv/pair page works as before.

### Updates from the app (Android)
- **Updating from the app now works**: the download used to stop with an error just before installing.
- If you're on a test version, the next test version is offered without turning on "Beta versions".
- The remote clearly shows which button is selected, and permission to install apps is asked before downloading.
- **One-time step**: versions up to 0.9.4 still have the issue. Install this version by hand once (Downloader or the APK below); after that, updates install from the app.

### Casting
- **Original voices and subtitles (VOST) are kept** when casting to a Solea box or TV, as in the player.
- A short network drop no longer switches a Chromecast to Google's player: Solea's screen is tried again.
- **Settings › About › Detailed log** is much more complete (network, player, casting, conversions), to understand a problem.

## Downloads

- **Android box, Android TV, Fire TV, Android phones and tablets**: `Solea-0.9.5-android.apk`
- **Windows**: `Solea-0.9.5-Setup.exe` (installer) or `Solea-0.9.5-windows.zip` (portable)
- **iPhone, iPad**: with SideStore, see [solea.tv/en/install-iphone](https://solea.tv/en/install-iphone/)

Questions and feedback: [Discord](https://discord.gg/42FVvupACy). Solea is a player: it provides no content and no subscription.

## Test version

### Solea on your Chromecast
- **Solea's own Chromecast screen**: Solea colours, a loading screen with the film's picture, a pause screen with the title, synopsis and time left, and clear messages when a video can't be played.
- **Next episode**: a card with a countdown appears on the TV during the end credits, and the episode starts by itself, keeping the voices and subtitles you chose.
- **Skip intro / recap** from the Solea remote, or automatically if set so in Settings › Playback.
- **Live channels**: channel logo, current and next programme on screen for a few seconds, and Dolby sound converted so it plays.
- **Subtitles from the file itself** when it has them in your language, always in sync; subtitles found online are only used otherwise. They follow your Settings › Subtitles style (size, colour, background).
- **4K TVs and amplifiers**: Dolby sound is sent as is when the TV or amplifier can play it; a 1080p version is picked only when the sound has to be converted.
- **Smoother playback** on modest TVs.

### Casting
- **Pick the TV again to get back in control**: if Solea was closed while casting, choosing the same Chromecast or Solea box brings back the remote for what's playing.
- **AirPlay from iPhone and iPad** to an Apple TV or an AirPlay TV.
- **"Cast to…" shows the kind of device** (Solea box, TV, Chromecast, Google TV) and casting messages are shorter.
- **Only TVs show up as receivers** (box, Fire TV, Android TV, Samsung TV), no longer Android phones.
- **DLNA TVs** (Samsung, LG) get subtitles too.
- **"Keep Solea open"** is shown only when the video goes through this device.

## Downloads

- **Android box, Android TV, Fire TV, Android phones and tablets**: `Solea-0.9.4-android.apk`
- **Windows**: `Solea-0.9.4-Setup.exe` (installer) or `Solea-0.9.4-windows.zip` (portable)
- **iPhone, iPad**: with SideStore, see [solea.tv/en/install-iphone](https://solea.tv/en/install-iphone/)

Questions and feedback: [Discord](https://discord.gg/42FVvupACy). Solea is a player: it provides no content and no subscription.

## Test version

### Lighter Android app
- **New audio decoder** for the sound a box or phone can't play by itself (DTS, TrueHD, Dolby Digital…).
- **The Android app is more than twice as small**: about 38 MB instead of 90 MB.

### Remote control
- **The PIN code pad can be used in full with the remote**: ▼ from the first row no longer gets lost.
- **Settings**: ▲ ▼ stay in the page instead of jumping to a category on the left, and the data sources in About can be read to the bottom.

### Error log
- **Settings › About › Detailed log**: adds diagnostic notes (device discovery…) to the error log, useful when reporting a problem. Off by default, on this device only.

## Downloads

- **Windows**: `Solea-0.9.3-Setup.exe` (installer) or `Solea-0.9.3-windows.zip` (portable)
- **iPhone, iPad**: with SideStore, see [solea.tv/en/install-iphone](https://solea.tv/en/install-iphone/)

Questions and feedback: [Discord](https://discord.gg/42FVvupACy). Solea is a player: it provides no content and no subscription.

## Test version

- **Player controls easier to read** on bright pictures: darker shade behind the controls, play and ±10 s on dark circles (phones).
- **Finding your devices**: detailed diagnostic notes in Settings › About › Error log, to understand why an iPhone doesn't find a Solea box or computer. Copy the log and send it on [Discord](https://discord.gg/42FVvupACy).
- Fewer network errors in the log when the iPhone goes to the background.

## Downloads

- **Android box, Android TV, Fire TV, Android phones and tablets**: `Solea-0.9.1-android.apk`
- **Windows**: `Solea-0.9.1-Setup.exe` (installer) or `Solea-0.9.1-windows.zip` (portable)
